text.description_html:
RK International CK-5214, Simple Knob with Polished Brass Insert

RK International's Simple Cabinet Knob is available in 3 finish combinations (click on picture to see them): a polished chrome, oil rubbed bronze, and polished brass--each of which have a polished brass center insert. This cabinet knob has a 1-1/4 inch diameter. Features an easy installation and it comes packaged with all the necessary installation hardware.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK-5214 Brass Center Simple Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: Brass
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 15/16"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
